Relevant Design

One idea.
Every expression.

Good design connects your message across the places people meet your business: on the road, in the shop, on paper, and online.

Logo design & brand identity

A mark, color direction, and visual identity that fit your organization—and make sense on a sign, a shirt, a business card, and a screen.

Marketing & campaign design

Graphics and messages for the products, services, and events you want people to notice. Build a consistent look across your materials.

Website design & redesign

A clear structure, useful content, and a mobile-friendly experience that guide customers toward the next step. Explore Rocket for ongoing website plans.

Church & school design

Creative work for churches, ministries, schools, and community organizations, from a campaign identity to printed and digital materials.

Photography & video

Website photography, edited imagery, and video development to help people understand your business. Scope and availability are quoted by project.

Content & creative direction

Help organizing your message, planning the work, and keeping the pieces connected—from the first idea through the finished project.

Planning your order

Show us where
the design will go.

A logo needs to work at different sizes and on different materials. Tell us where you plan to use it, send any existing artwork, and share a few references. We’ll work through the layout and prepare the approved design for the project.

Good to know

Before you order.

Call the shop at (601) 736-0663.

Contact Relevant↗
Do I need to know exactly what I want?

No. Bring the goal, a few examples of what you like, and what you want your customers to understand. We’ll help work through the creative direction.

Can you carry one design across everything?

Yes. We can coordinate your identity across signs, apparel, printed materials, and your website through our connected companies and brands.

Do you only design for Columbia businesses?

We’re based in Columbia, Mississippi, and work with clients across Mississippi and beyond. Tell us where you are and what the project needs.

What can we
make for you?

Tell us what you need, how many, and when you need it. We’ll help you work out the details.
